blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Perceiving objects through fragmented occlusions, such as foliage, is a natural capability of the human visual system but remains a fundamental challenge for computer vision. This work addresses the problem of object reconstruction, or de-occlusion, in the presence of high-density, fragmented occlusions. We propose a reconstruction framework that operates on a sequence of grayscale images of a moving object, acquired by a single camera, either stationary or in motion. The algorithm estimates the object's relative positions across frames by jointly registering the images and optimizing the alignment parameters to maximize the contrast of their average, referred to as the integrated image. This integrated image serves as the reconstructed representation of the object. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real video sequences demonstrate the feasibility of accurate reconstruction under occlusion densities exceeding 90%. The proposed approach is competitive with synthetic aperture techniques, which are limited to static objects and require complex camera setup with careful calibration. Furthermore, we show that the integrated image enables reliable object classification under severe occlusion when used as input to standard, off-the-shelf classifiers.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Fragmented occlusion occurs when an object is partially visible, such as through foliage, exposing its surface at different shattered image regions. Even if the camera or object is moving, the object is never fully visible.
In contrast to the human vision research community, we currently have very limited knowledge about vision under fragmented occlusion [ 7 , 40 , 39 , 10 ] .
It turns out that humans can effortlessly perceive such occluded objects. Despite some advancements, we still do not comprehend this remarkable human ability, and current recognition algorithms do not provide an explanation either [ 59 ] . Most algorithms are designed for the fully visible object. Even algorithms designed for recognition under partial occlusion [ 37 , 23 , 56 , 55 , 16 , 24 ] would not work satisfactorily under fragmented occlusion, as they need sufficiently large visible regions to extract features.
Although fragmented occlusion seems like a niche problem, the study of it will enhance our overall understanding of occlusion [ 45 ] , which remains a challenge, still significantly impacting recent research [ 51 ] .

虽然零散的隔离似乎是一个特殊问题,但研究它将增进我们对隔离的总体理解[45],这仍然是一个挑战,仍然对最近的研究产生重大影响[51]。

blocks.en:
As mentioned, psychologists have studied fragmented occlusion for a longer time. This area is known as dynamic perception [ 9 , 38 , 34 ] . They believe that our brain aggregates perceptual information over time and then reconstructs shape and appearance of such occluded objects. This paper is partially devoted to this belief.
The proposed 2D reconstruction algorithm takes a sequence of occluded images and provides a generated, integrated image where the object becomes more visible (see Fig. 1 ). The motivation is that recognition algorithms are not applied to the single occluded images, but to this integrated image. Thus, in a sense, the paper provides both, a computational model for the human ability to perceive occluded objects and the reconstruction algorithm for making occluded objects more visible, which we call object de-occlusion.

如前所述,心理学家长期研究了零散的隔离问题。 这一区域被称为动态感知 [9, 38, 34]. 他们相信,我们的大脑会逐渐积累知觉信息,然后重建这种被吞噬物体的形状和外观. 本文部分致力于这一信念。
所拟议的2D重建算法取出一个被覆盖的图像序列并提供一个生成,集成的图像,在物体更显眼的地方(见图一. 其动机是识别算法不应用于单个被覆盖的图像,而是应用于这个集成的图像. 因此,从某种意义上说,论文既提供了人类感知被吞噬物体能力的计算模型,又提供了使被吞噬物体更能被看见的重建算法,我们称之为"被吞噬物体".

blocks.en:
Given the limited literature, a possible algorithm for object de-occlusion is to reconstruct the complete 3D scene with voxel coloring [ 44 ] and then to delete the occluder voxels and project back all remaining scene elements into a reference camera [ 49 ] . This approach is very sensitive to the unknown object’s depth, which causes severe visible holes in the reconstruction.
Another way is to control the focal length and the aperture [ 11 ] . Such an algorithm is effective and may suit a human computational model, but it is very much limited to short distances in the micrometer range [ 32 ] .
Several algorithms, denoted as the synthetic aperture approach , address the object de-occlusion by combining data from multiple cameras. Even for a moderate 70 % occlusion, many cameras are needed, where these are usually arranged in arrays [ 48 , 49 ] or lines [ 36 , 21 ] ; e.g . 88 cameras are necessary in a foliage experiment [ 49 ] .
Alternatively, a camera rig on a drone [ 25 ] or camera on a computer controlled gantry [ 49 , 53 , 58 , 54 ] is used. Camera baselines are typically in the scale of the occluder size [ 26 ] . Such apparatuses use RGB cameras [ 53 ] , thermal, event cameras [ 58 , 54 ] , or combinations [ 31 , 29 ] and apply neural networks for better reconstruction [ 53 , 57 , 18 ] , but
the approach is generally limited by the need for static scenes and calibrated cameras, which are difficult to obtain in foliage.

另一种方法是控制焦距和孔径[11]. 这种算法是有效的,可能适合人类的计算模型,但是它非常局限在微米范围内的短距离[32].

blocks.en:
This paper presents a further algorithm for object de-occlusion which uses video. This approach assumes a single uncalibrated camera and exploits the visual parallax between the camera and the object in the images of the sequence. The approach also assumes that the object parts become visible as they move. Our algorithm is conceptually simple: The images are first warped, so that the occluded object becomes stationary, and then the registered images are averaged together to create a single image containing the more visible object, while other image regions become blurred.
Despite occlusion, this is achieved using a parametric motion model [ 6 ] and by maximizing contrast within a window in the integrated image to robustly estimate the motion parameters.
We test this robustness on real video and synthetic images, using a new simulation that mimics foliage. We found that the algorithm reconstructs objects when they are barely visible, with an occlusion density of as high as 92.3 %.
We also combine this new algorithm for object de-occlusion with zero-shot object classification, resulting in a 68 % reduction in the classification error rate for such 90 % occluded images.
blocks.zh:
本文进一步介绍了使用视频的物体去封存算法。 这种方法假设一个单一的未校正相机,并利用相机和相机中相机和相机图像中的物体之间的可视平面. 这种方法还假定物体部分在移动时会变得明显. 我们的算法在概念上很简单: 图像被先被扭曲,使被吞噬的物体变成静止的,然后被平均地将所注册的图像一起生成一个包含更可见物体的单一图像,而其他图像区域变得模糊.
尽管被隔离,但使用参数运动模型[6]实现这一点,并通过在集成图像的窗口内使对比最大化来强力地估计运动参数.
我们在真实的视频和合成图像上测试这种强健性, 使用模仿叶片的新模拟。 我们发现,算法在物体几乎不可见时重建出物体,其被遮住的密度高达92.3%.
我们还将这个用于对象去隔离的新算法与零射出对象分类法结合起来,使这种90%被闭合的图像的分类误差率降低了68%.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Registering sequentially acquired data and integrating it into a single representation has been previously discussed in a few papers: some studies of motion computation with two consecutive images [ 20 ] and with event data [ 13 , 14 ] , for the application of de-fencing [ 35 ] , for the synthetic aperture approach with a thermal camera on a flying drone [ 27 ] , and for the inverse synthetic aperture approach using radar [ 50 ] or airborne thermal images [ 3 ] .
Our algorithm differs from these papers by using a windowed contrast function to determine motion from the integrated image.
blocks.zh:
以前在几篇论文中讨论过按顺序登记获得的数据并将其并入单一表示法:一些关于用两个连续图像[20]和事件数据[13,14]进行运动计算的研究,以应用去风化[35],在飞行无人机上使用热相机的合成孔径方法[27],以及使用雷达[50]或空中热相机的反相合成孔径方法[3].
我们的算法与这些论文不同,使用窗口对比函数来决定从集成图像中运动.

blocks.en: Joint 2D reconstruction and motion computation are already considered [ 22 , 43 , 33 , 47 ] . These algorithms either alternate between optical flow estimation and reconstruction [ 43 , 33 ] , or solve both tasks simultaneously using a neural network [ 47 ] . The proposed algorithm, while potentially linked to these papers, focuses on fragmental occlusion. These earlier works fail to handle fragmental occlusion because they rely on optical flow, which is undefined for occluded pixels [ 4 ] , or because of fundamental limitations of convolutional neural networks with occlusion [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 已经考虑过联合2D重建和运动计算[22、43、33、47]。 这些算法要么在光学流估计与重建[43,33]之间取而代之,要么利用神经网络同时解决这两个任务[47]. 所拟议的算法虽然可能与这些论文相联,但侧重于分块封存. 这些早期的作品由于依赖于光学流而未能处理出片分闭塞,而光学流对于被闭塞的像素[4]是没有定义的,或者由于带有闭塞[1]的进化神经网络的根本局限性.

blocks.en:
The work most similar to this paper is described in [ 3 ] . Their reconstruction relies on the infrared domain and fails with visible images.
Our approach differs from this paper in two ways: we use selective windowing on the occluded object to enhance contrast measurement, and we use a coherent motion model.
The proposed algorithm can now be applied to visible images and successfully de-occludes the reference image. In [ 3 ] , the authors manually set the motion parameters. We also introduce a new fragmental occlusion simulation to evaluate the algorithm. Finally, we demonstrate that classification under dense occlusion is feasible by feeding the integrated image into a standard classifier.
blocks.zh:
与本文最相近的工作在[3]中被描述. 他们的重建依赖于红外线领域,并失败了可见的图像.
我们的方法与本文有两种不同:我们用有选择的窗口对被包围的物体加强对比度量,我们使用一个连贯的运动模型.
拟议的算法现在可以被应用到可见的图像上,并成功去除参考图像. [3]中,作者手动设定了运动参数. 我们还引入了新的分块闭塞模拟法来评价算法. 最后,我们通过将集成的图像输入一个标准分类器来证明,在密集隔离下进行分类是可行的。

On the other hand, the less accurate the warping is, the lower the contrast of the integrated image will be, because large areas in the integrated image are blurred due to the averaging process. This makes the sample variance smaller. This is a simple criterion but it has one important advantage: the contrast is a smooth function of the warping accuracy. This was confirmed in our experiments.
Note that alternative, seemingly improved, criteria, such as the use of robust integration [ 49 ] will lose this property. We also experimented with more complex gradient based cost functions (see [ 14 ] ) and found that they induce a harder search space, with many local maxima. The pixel intensities in the integrated image results from warping and averaging and are not identical to intensities in the raw images.

blocks.en: Following the scene model outlined in Sec. 3 , we generate eight-bit, grayscale images using Luxor ( https://juliapackages.com/p/luxor ). Fig. 1 is an example. The background behind the object and the foreground, which also comprises the occluder, are set to a mid-gray value of 128 128 . The foreground is composed of randomly placed and oriented triangles that may overlap one another [ 8 ] . Uniformly varying the triangles’ size controls the occlusion density ρ \rho (%) up to a small, random deviation. This occlusion model mimics foliage reasonably. For a different model see [ 26 ] .

These categories are inspired by [ 28 ] and adapted to our project needs. The 24 used text labels are found in Sec. 6 of the supp. material. Finally, we encode the tokenized text labels into the same CLIP space. No training is done. Metric: Let 𝐩 \mathbf{p} and 𝐪 \mathbf{q} be two features of image and text respectively.

These categories are inspired by [ 28 ] and adapted to our project needs. The 24 used text labels are found in Sec. 6 of the supp. material. Finally, we encode the tokenized text labels into the same CLIP space. No training is done. Metric: Let 𝐩 \mathbf{p} and 𝐪 \mathbf{q} be two features of image and text respectively.

blocks.en: 4.5 Discussion of Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4.5 关于实验结果的讨论

blocks.en:
The reconstruction quality is comparable to that obtained from synthetic apertures using stereo [ 49 ] , but our algorithm maintains its accuracy for higher occlusion densities, exceeding 70 % 70\,\% .
This is due to the proposed coherent motion computation, which is more robust to occlusion. We found that the quality primarily depends on the scene specific motion and occlusion patterns, rather than the video length, which is known for a long time [ 20 ] .

blocks.en:
A classification algorithm, combining the proposed reconstruction and a zero-shot CLIP classification, achieves a high, 70.0 % top1 accuracy for images with approximately 90 % occlusion.
This is remarkable because applying CLIP on the occluded image leads to 2.0 % accuracy, which is close the chance level.
blocks.zh:
一种分类算法,结合了拟议的重建与零发CLIP分类,实现了图像高,70.0%的上1精度,包含了约90%的隐蔽.
这很出人意料,因为将 CLIP 应用在被覆盖的图像上,会导致2.0%的精度,这接近了机会水平.

blocks.en:
Interestingly, f f in Eq. 15 has local maxima corresponding to all scene motions, and motion computation involves searching for all maxima.
In comparison to alternative algorithms such as optical flow [ 17 ] and motion layers [ 52 ] , this approach is robust to occlusion and does not require the number of motions given.
The same computational process is used for both finding the motion and for reconstruction.

有趣的是,Eq. 15中的f f有与所有场景运动对应的局部最大值,而运动计算则涉及搜索所有最大值.
相较于光学流[17]和运动层[52]等替代算法,这种方法对于被遮住是稳健的,不需要给定的运动次数.
同样的计算过程用于查找运动和进行重建。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en:
The paper proposes an algorithm to reconstruct or de-occlude an object behind fragmented occlusion. It is an alternative to synthetic aperture techniques, and relies on motion between the object and the camera.
Averaging registered images to create an integrated image and using sample variance as a contrast measure yields local maxima under certain conditions, as discussed in this paper. These maxima determine the object’s motion, and the resulting reconstructed object.
Using the integrated image and CLIP as a straightforward zero-shot classifier, achieves an impressive average 70.0 % accuracy for images with 90 % occlusion. This is significant because no other known classifiers perform well under such conditions.
The algorithm is simple but provides useful results up to 90 % occlusion density and significantly improves state-of-the-art performance.
More complex motion models or robust estimation for generating the integrated image, have the potential to improve the results.
Learning can be used throughout the process, but we did not use it yet to reduce the risk of hallucinations. We are currently investigating these directions.
blocks.zh:
论文提出一种算法,以重建或去蔽被零碎地隔离后的一个物体. 它是合成孔径技术的替代品,依赖于物体和相机之间的运动.
如本文件所讨论,利用已登记的图像生成一个综合图像,并利用样本差异作为对比度量,在某些条件下产生局部最大值。 这些最大值决定物体的运动,以及由此而来重建的物体。
将集成图像和CLIP作为直截了当的零镜头分级器,以90%的被封入的图像平均实现令人印象深刻的70.0%的精度. 这一点很重要,因为没有其他已知的分类人员在这种条件下表现良好。
算法很简单,但提供了可达到90%的隔离密度的有用结果,并大大提高了最先进的性能.
更复杂的运动模型或生成综合图像的可靠估计,有可能改进结果。
学习可以在整个过程中使用,但我们还没有使用它来降低幻觉的风险. 我们目前正在调查这些方向。

blocks.en:
The work focuses on psychological studies in dynamic perception.
The registration in the algorithm can be seen as a fixation on the object. Interestingly, a human fixation on a point makes the rest of the retinal image blurry, a phenomenon known as Troxler’s fading [ 2 ] , but also observed in the integrated image. While the common explanation to the Troxler’s fading is different, it would be interesting to see whether the algorithm provides a relevant explanation.
blocks.zh:
作品侧重于动态认知中的心理研究.
算法中的注册可以看作是对对象的固定. 有趣的是,在某一点上的人类固定使得视网膜图像的其余部分模糊不清,这种现象被称作"特罗克斯勒的消亡[2]",但也被综合图像所观察到. 虽然对特罗克勒消亡的共同解释不同,但想知道算法是否提供了相关的解释.

blocks.en: 9 Variance: Failure Case
blocks.zh: 第9条 差异:失败

blocks.en: Motion computation in Eq. 13 successfully works for all 300 synthetic image sequences in Sec. 4 . However, when applied to real image sequences, the integrated sample variance becomes significantly larger than the variance associated with the occluded object. Consequently, the function f f fails to attain its maximum value. This raises the question of the conditions under which motion computation may fail.
blocks.zh: Eq. 13中的运动计算成功适用于Sec. 4中的所有300个合成图像序列。 然而,当被应用到真实的图像序列中时,集成的样本差异会大大大于与被覆盖对象相关的差异. 因此,ff函数未能达到最大值。 这就提出了动议计算可能失败的条件问题。

blocks.en: To study such conditions, we generated a sequence of 21 synthetic images, showing an artificial box under occlusion density ρ = 49.3 % \rho=49.3\,\% (see Fig. 13 ). The box’s brightness value is mid-gray (128), the background white (255), and the occluder black (0). Fig. 12 illustrates the results. Motion computation fails under these conditions, because the range of the average brightness values within the integrated image includes the brightness value of the box object. This can be nicely seen by the histograms’ spreads for the different motion parameters α \alpha and β \beta in Eq. 19 .
blocks.zh: 为了研究这些条件,我们生成了一个由21个合成图像组成的序列,显示一个在闭塞密度 ^ 49.3%\rho=49.3\\\(见图13)。 盒子的亮度值为中灰色(128),背景为白色(255),而占地者为黑色(0). 图12说明了结果。 在这些条件下,运动计算失败了,因为集成图像中的平均亮度值的范围包括了框对象的亮度值. 不同运动参数α-α和β-β在Eq. 19的直方图的分布可以很好地看到这一点。

blocks.en: We conducted another experiment with the Park sequence, computing the sample variance for different fixation windows. These windows vary in size and capture the object or parts of it. Fig. 14 shows the results of this experiment. The sample variance is similar across window sizes for incorrect object motions. However, for small windows with larger object regions, the sample variance suddenly increases for the correct motion α = 6.0 \alpha=6.0 .
blocks.zh: 计算不同固定窗口的样本差异 这些窗口大小不同,可以捕捉其对象或部分. 图14显示了这个实验的结果. 对于不正确的对象运动,不同窗口大小的样本差异类似. 然而,对于对象区域较大的小窗口,为正确运动α = 6.0\alpha = 6.0.

blocks.en: We conclude that motion computation fails if the object brightness values are a subset of the integrated image. This is because there are no distinctive brightness values to increase variance, so f f does not attain a maximum for the correct motion. This is a fundamental limitation of variance in our algorithm. This may also explain Vaish et al . ’s observation that shape-from-focus (SfF) performs better. SfF exploits texture by incorporating image gradients instead of brightness values, which leads to better results [ 49 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们的结论是,如果对象亮度值是集成图像的一个子集,则运动计算失败。 这是因为没有明显的亮度值来增加相差,所以ff没有达到正确运动的最大值. 这是我们算法中差异的根本限制。 这也可以解释Vaish等人的看法,即从重点看形状效果更好。 SfF通过收录图像梯度而不是亮度值来利用纹理,从而导致更好的结果 [49].
